inputs.text: An extreme close-up, dead-on view of a brown-haired girl's face framed entirely by a thick mass of sunflower petals and broad green leaves that press in from every edge of the frame. Her tousled bangs fall between her eyes, and her large, pale blue eyes with layered lashes hold a still, unblinking gaze aimed just past the camera. Vivid leaf shadows and bright petal highlights scatter across her cheeks and the bridge of her nose in broken patches, while her mouth is barely visible at the lower edge, half swallowed by the foreground. Oversized sunflower heads dominate the foreground, their yellow petals fading out of focus and dissolving into soft bokeh, with one blurred bloom sweeping up from the bottom right. Sunlight pours down through the canopy above, striking her skin in hard, warm patches and pooling into deep, saturated green shadow, while a single glassy dewdrop clings to a leaf beside her temple and fine strands of hair lift slightly at the edges of the frame.
